avis.titre: This will be a forever repurchase for me.
avis.texte: I was influenced by social media, but worried about purchasing this because of the high price for so little sunscreen. The skincare influencers of color, did not lie about this product. This was my first day using it, and I'm liking it so much. It does leave a glow on your skin, and doesn't make your skin feel dry like so many other mineral spf's. It blends very well with my skin tone, and you can't tell that it's a mineral spf.
I love this product. I've been buying directly from Bloom Effects and saw Ulta was offering. I wish Ulta offered the larger size that is available on the Bloom Effects website.

avis.titre: I would by this product over and over again!!!
avis.texte: I'd be on a search for a mineral tinted sunscreen that didn't leave my skin feeling sticky and heavy! This one has exceeded my expectations! I love the serum consistency & the fact that I feel like there's nothing on my face! Already planning on repurchasing!

This is a decent tinted sunscreen. It is glowy and transfers a bit but tends to work well under a good primer. I prefer this over the Whipped Butter creme which is just like spreading oil on your face. It's a bit pricey for just 1oz and not my favorite mineral sunscreen, but a nice option if you like this brand and its formulation.

The Dew serum bronze tinted sunscreen is amazing on my skin and match my skin tone very well. I did not have any irritation or discomfort when I applied it on my face, which is great because I have a sensitive combinations skin. When I applied it, I let it set for 15 minutes and go in with a finishing powder on my oily areas and brush the excess powder off. I purchased a second one because it is so good and will be continuing to purchase more! Love it!
This sunscreen is light, non irritating and gives the most incredible glow. I've never used a mineral sunscreen that has checked all boxes like Bloomeffects. I've already bought more for backup!

I absolutely love this product! I have been using it as a staple in my routine for over 2 years now and I love having quality SPF in my skin routine on the daily now! I finally started to invest in quality skincare rather than more expensive makeup and I literally wish I could give out little samples! The subscription is AMAZING too... Less thinking more living!
The other products like this that I've used have eventually caused sensitivity issues. This has been very gentle on my skin and leaves a nice glow.
This is just perfect. It looks so lovely on my skin. I'm very fair and it's perfect. I'll definitely purchase again.

This product leaves my skin glowing, with a light coverage that wears beautifully for everyday. The SPF in this product does not cause my eyes irritation and that is a major win! My only piece of feedback would be with the bottle design, opening it being confusing upon first use. However, I know this products packaging has been reimagined and I can't wait to give it a try when I run out.
consistency of product was nice. Goes on smooth . I received a very dark color so not sure if blends in well.

avis.titre: Glow shade works for fair neutral skin tones
avis.texte: I purchased this product and am NOT incentivized in any way to write this review. I have fair neutral skin and have a very hard time finding tinted mineral sunscreen that does not make me look orange. The "Glow" shade blends in with my skin to the point where it is completely undetectable. It has a thin consistency that makes it hard to believe it can be SPF 50. My skin is on the drier side but is acne prone and sensitive, and after this product sets, its like I have nothing on my skin which is so nice for a sunscreen. Love that there is zero fragrance. My only gripe is the high price for such a small amount of product. But it is a really good one!

I am ridiculously sensitive to most facial products and that includes spf either chemical or mineral. This is the first sunscreen that I can wear all day without irritation. My biggest fear is that this little company gets bought by a big one and they ruin this formula.

Love this sunscreen! I appreciate mineral sunscreen because I have sensitive skin and the glow I get is amazing. It's perfect for my dry skin. The packaging is beautiful however I do wish it was a little more practical for travel. I'm constantly putting my sunscreen in my purse to reapply when I run errands or when I travel locally or to another country and wish it was a little more compact or in a tube.
This has a really good SPF level but I thought with the description DEW that it would be hydrating enough to skip extra moisturizer but it was not/ Works well with a seperate moisturizer unerneath

avis.titre: THE BEST MINERAL SPF FOR DARK SKIN
avis.texte: Shade I purchased: Bronze This is hands down the best mineral sunscreen for darker complexions. For context I'm shade Zambie in the Nars foundation. This didnt give me a white cast AT ALL even with 12% zinc oxide. I will continue to buy!
I love this product because it is a lovely serum with sunscreen, so it streamlines my morning routine. The serum is soft and spreadable and leaves a nice dewy finish. The packaging is pretty as well.

This suns team is like a slick creamy silky Dewey texture - which I love. It doesn't dry chalky and it doesn't cake up after hours in your face. I easily reapply throughout day. Doesn't have a bad smell like most sunscreens. I also don't breakout using this - it's likely doesn't clog my pores. I don't love the limited colors (the light is too light and the glow bronze is too reddish and dark for me) but it can be mixed with foundation etc. I don't love how small the new packaging is for the cost.

I've used this serum for about a week and I'm loving it! Really light-weight and absorbs fast, and works great with my other products. I notice an improved glow to my skin, and most importantly for me, it doesn't irritate my skin! I have really bad skin allergies, so a new skincare product can cause bad flare ups. I was admittedly a little nervous to try Bloomeffects because botanical ingredients can sometimes irritate my skin, but this serum (and the rest of their line) has worked so well either way my skin! If anything, I think the tulip complex helps calm my skin and helps it heal faster after a flare up.

This provides great sun protection and skincare. It does take a little time to completely set. The texture is very fluid and the finish is very dewy/shiny. It does work well with makeup, but you do need to wait to apply makeup, maybe 10-15 min. This could replace moisturizer if you have normal to slightly oily skin. In my opinion, if you have oily skin this might slide right off, you'd absolutely need a setting powder. It has no fragrance! The tint basically just prevents white cast. I got the glow shade. I have really sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions.

I received Tulipscreen Suncreen through BzzAgent. I really liked this product! It glided on my face smoothly and covered the uneven spots on my face. It looked very natural and it did not feel heavy or sticky.

avis.titre: I would definitely purchase in the future
avis.texte: I'm not normally a person that likes dewy skin but this looked amazing and the coverage was great. I'm normally someone who prefers matte skin but this glow was subtle but there. LoVed that it was also a sunscreen perfect for a spring time glow you normally get during summer.
The sermon goes on smooth. I am sensitive to Jodie's and this worked great. Not sticky. Goes on even. The shade I had was super dark. I will use it more in the summer
This sunscreen has become my holy grail product for my sensitive, rosacea and eczema prone skin. It gives me a lovely glow and I don't feel the need to wear foundation over it.

Apply 15 minutes before sun exposure, then reapply. After 40 minutes of swimming immediately after tail, drying and at least every 2 hours. I really enjoyed this because I when I have not been out in the sun, my face is pale, but I can put this on and it covers my flaws and my splotchy skin. I also like the fact that I can't feel it on my face..

avis.titre: Highly recommended, I would definately buy
avis.texte: I really like that the product goes on smooth and it has SPF 50. I also like that it has a light fragrance and doesn't smell bad. At first I thought it was too dark, but it blends in so well with my skin. I am hoping that the full size product would be easier to put on a larger area of the body. I would recommend this product and would definitely purchase this item.

I've been using this for a few weeks now and I really like how it looks so natural on my skin! It's very lightweight and pretty undetectable! It adds such a healthy glow making my skin look healthy and youthful!

I was skeptical at first on this sunscreen when I saw the color it came out on my finger but then after applying and waiting the 15 minutes, it blended naturally into my skin and the color was natural looking. It had no scent which was great and it wasn't oily. Left my skin feeling smooth and since it was a sunscreen, I knew my skin was protected.

This Tulipscreen dew serum bronze by Bloomeffects is a must have not just for summer but for all year round!! I'm confident in knowing thar my skin is protected from harmful sunlight because the serum comes with an SPF of 50. Bloomeffects made this serum so silky smooth and added some tint that goes hand in hand with that summer glow! This fantastic serum has officially taken the place of of my regular sunscreen AND bronzer!!! I highly recommend!!

I love that this sunscreen actually goes on so smooth and evenly. No white cast - it blends in so nicely with my skin tone. It is easy to apply and reapply which is exactly what you need with sunscreen! It's not too heavy and easy to build on.

I wasn't sure what to expect with this. When I tell you I'm shook. First of all the color matched perfectly on my skin. For reference I wear drug store maybelline n10 and fenty 440. The scent is light and it dries on silky. The finish is a light dewy look and doesn't look like I'm drenched in oil. I would absolutely get more once this is done. I was sent this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.
I love that this sunscreen is so lightweight AND waterproof too. Excellent coverage, and only slightly tinted.

This bronze tinted dew serum is great. I was actually surprised that it worked so well with my skin tone. It's hard to find tinted products that look good on brown skin. As long as you don't use too much you can blend it in pretty well, it has a nice texture and the spf 50 make it even better. All skin types and colors benefit from a good sunscreen protection.

My go-to for low-effort, high-result mornings. The bronze tint sinks right in. There's no white cast, just a subtle warmth that evens out your complexion and gives you that "I caught a little sun" glow. It's lightweight, non-comedogenic, and somehow manages to be more moisturizing than most mineral sunscreens I've tried. A genuine multitasker that's simplified my routine. When my 67 year old mom — currently undergoing cancer treatment — needed a gentle sunscreen recommendation, this was my first and only suggestion. She loves it too. That says everything. My only con (why I gave it 4 stars) is that it seemed to flake under powder after several hours but that may just be user error.

avis.titre: Nothing like the Golden Time of the day
avis.texte: I really, like really enjoyed using the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze sunscreen! It gave my skin an extremely healthy, natural bronzed glow without sacrificing my skin to harmful UV rays. My face has not gotten irritated from usage and I must say, many products that double as a sunscreen normally have a cast to them, this one does not! I've gotten so many compliments on how dewy and bronzed my skin look, more than I've gotten in the past using a traditional bronzer. I am definitely a fan!!

Where has this been all my life! This is by far the best facial sunscreen I have found. Ive tried so many however they usually dont soak in my skin all the way or leaves my skin sticky. This sunscreen however soaks into my skin, leaves a natural glow and its clean ingredients. I only use mineral sunscreens mainly sunscreens with non nano zinc oxide. I highly recommend this. I love it so much, I bought two more.

I was SO excited to try Bloomeffects Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze. I have tan skin with yellow/golden undertones and felt like the bronze would be perfect as I like a bronzed look while giving me SPF protection. This was way, way too dark even following the instructions exactly and shaking vigorously prior to application. The consistency is very nice, it does go on well but the color deposits quickly and while smooth, I had a challenging time blending. I also felt like I was hesitant to get good SPF coverage with the product as it was so dark, the only way I found I could wear it was blended with a moisturizer to tone it down some. Due to the intensity of the color, I would not personally recommend or rebuy this one, even though it did have a lot of good things I liked including consistency, awesome ingredients and cruelty free.

After I am done with my face routine, I use this at the end. I am Indian so it's hard to find anything that comes close to my color. This was awesome since I felt as soon as I put it on, it was lightweight and it made my skin the same color as before.

First, I love the serum as a sunscreen because a lot of sunscreens can be thick and chalky (even when they advertise that it isn't). This is a great way to get a subtle tint and dewy look to your skin. Secondly, I love that it's SPF50. It feels lightweight and moisturizing.

Living in Southern California Sunscreen is a necessity year round and having a Bronzing tint is a bonus. I used the Bloomeffects Dew Serum this weekend in Santa Barbara and I feel it protected my face for 3 hours I was in direct sunlight. The product was a bit oily for me which is why I left 4 stars. The product would be great for those with dry skin.

avis.titre: Great product but needs more color options
avis.texte: Feels lightweight and blends in well. Very easy to apply. Unfortunately Bronze was a touch too dark for me. It does give a beautiful glow!!

avis.titre: I recommend this product to everyone!
avis.texte: This product is great, feels silky smooth, goes on light and not greasy at all. It seemed a little dark at first but does lighten as I rubbed it in. I really appreciate the smell, was not strong at all, very subtle and nice. I like the packaging and the size is perfect, overall it is a great product that I would recommend to everyone.

avis.titre: Perfect for those "no-makeup, just glow" days
avis.texte: I've been really enjoying this sunscreen lately. The texture feels more like a lightweight serum than a typical SPF, so it absorbs quickly and doesn't feel heavy on the skin. The bronze tint gives such a beautiful healthy glow , it subtly evens out my complexion and makes my skin look fresh and radiant without looking like makeup. It layers well under the rest of my skincare and doesn't feel greasy throughout the day. Definitely a great option if you like a natural glowy finish while still protecting your skin.
This sunscreen was lightweight and blended seamlessly into my skin. I have darker skin and had no issue the the tint. I did receive this product for free but my opinion is my own.

avis.titre: Not a product for olive skin!
avis.texte: Upon receiving Tulipscreen from Bloom Effects and a thank you to BuzzAgents for the opportunity to review their newest product Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze, is a new and interesting sunscreen however it did not provide the results I hoped for. When I received the package the bottle is cute and small for putting inside your purse for future use, looks convenient to carry. Great color, and unique. Upon applying the sunscreen it had a great texture and looked very nice. I applied to my face and the bronze turned my face yellow, and it was very noticeable that something was off. This happened seconds after applying and had multiple people ask me if I was sick. My face stayed yellow even after I removed the sunscreen! I don't recommend this product to people with an olive skin tone. The product did not wear off u til the following day. If you try this product be advised of it altering your skin tone.
Loved this product right when I first apply it and few hours after but by hour 6 it makes me look a little oily which isn't ideal. Not a major deal breaker but something to note.

I received the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze (30ml) for free in exchange for my honest review through BzzAgent. All opinions are my own. I was really excited to try this sunscreen because I love products that combine skincare with a bronzed glow. The texture felt lightweight and smooth going on, and it blended easily at first. Unfortunately, the shade didn't work well for my skin tone. It gave me an ashen, almost dirty look rather than a natural bronze. I even went to the store to check other shades, but they all seemed to have a similar undertone that didn't complement my complexion. Another downside for me was the scent. It had a noticeable clay-like smell that lingered even after washing it off, which I found unpleasant. Overall, while the formula felt nice, the shade range and scent didn't work for me personally.

avis.titre: Has replaced all other bronzing drop!
avis.texte: I am honestly obsessed with this bronzing serum. It gives the most beautiful, natural glow without looking heavy or orange. The formula is lightweight, blends seamlessly into my skin, and layers perfectly with my makeup or even on its own for a more natural look. What I love most is that it gives me that "sun-kissed" finish while still feeling like skincare. It doesn't feel greasy, doesn't clog my pores, and wears well throughout the day. I've tried so many bronzing drops, and this one has completely replaced them all. If you're looking for an easy, effortless glow with added skin benefits, this is it!

I recieved the Tulipscreen dew serum Bronze in exchange for my opinion. I like how easy to blend was. it is buildable. It gives a natural glow bronze, perfect for the summer. A little goes a long way just depends how bronze you want it.

avis.titre: Get that sun-kissed glow while keeping your skin protected!
avis.texte: I love the tint this gives my skin! It's super nice and not too greasy. Plus, it's SPF 50, which is awesome! Definitely recommend it.
Lightweight sunscreen with a great color match. It was dewy without looking greasy. I also liked that the product can be squeezed out instead of having a pump.
I love how well this blended into the skin and it didn't leave a white cast!
I haven't tried the reformulated version but the original left me pretty greasy so I dont know what to expect with the new version but I love this brand enough to give it a try

This is one of those sunscreens that actually makes your skin look better while protecting it. The texture is super lightweight, almost like a serum, and it blends in effortlessly without feeling greasy or heavy. The bronze tint gives a subtle glow that evens out the complexion and adds warmth without looking orange or streaky. What really stands out is the dewy finish. It leaves my skin looking hydrated and radiant, like a natural no-makeup glow. It layers well under makeup but also just looks great on its own for casual days when you just want skin that looks healthy and luminous. I also appreciate that it doesn't leave a white cast, which is a huge plus for medium to deeper skin tones. The only downside for me is that the shade runs a bit dark for my skin tone. I really wish it came in multiple tint options because the formula itself is beautiful. I'd absolutely repurchase if there were a slightly lighter bronze shade. Overall, this is a gorgeous everyday sunscreen that doubles as a glow booster. If you like radiant, bronzed skin with lightweight sun protection, this one is definitely worth trying.

This sunscreen looked way too light straight from the bottle, but blends in well even using the recommended 1/4 tap amount. It does take a little while to settle in before it doesn't transfer. I took off a star because it does give a nice glow, but under certain lights, it glows purple. I'm only using this on my days at home.

I was able to try this serum for free and write an honest review. The packaging is very informative stating Vitamin and Mineral tinted sunscreen with 50 spf. Water resistant and fragrance free. I like the size and shape of the 30ml or 1 oz bottle. They note that this is a serum but feel it's more like a tinted moisturiser. I applied this with my finger tips. It went on dark but then lightened up as I continued to rub in. It gave a nice color and coverage. Not sure if I should have had a lighter shade? I believe if I would have my normal moisturiser on prior to applying it, then it may have went on smoother. The reason I'm giving it three stars is because the words Dew Serum. I was expecting it lighter and not so much color. I think if it said tinted moisturiser with sunscreen, I'd have been happier knowing that was what I was getting. I did not feel it was very hydrating. I truly believe the shade was too dark for my skin tone. Dew Serum is good product but not for me. I normally don't wear makeup.

I received this product to try it and my first impression is good. In general it's a serum very fluid my color is bronze and I think is a little bit darker for my skin color. I'm a tan skin color. But nothing that I can fixed with my lighter foundation. Easy to blend with my hands and when I apply my foundation everything look nice.

When I first opened the tint I was extra worried that it would be too dark. With a little product and careful application, I ended up loving it! The tint blends in and made my skin glow without feeling heavy or leaving a white tint. I love that its a mineral based sunscreen and doesn't have that terrible smell associated with it. Although it took a couple attempts to blend it evenly, once I figured it out I loved using it and am using it now that it's sunny out! I received this product for promotional reasons for my honest review.

avis.titre: I love the product but I picked a color too dark for my face
avis.texte: Lightweight and buildable and easy to apply - I picked a shade too dark for my face which was completely my fault. But I still was able to use it in my chest and arms because those are much darker than my face. Non greasy and perfect for lightweight sun protection at the baseball fields!
Really loved this! Enjoyed trying it all thanks to receiving it free from BzzAgent

What a perfect sunscreen! It's light and easy to apply without added weight to my skin. No white residue and it blends easily which is hard to do for a mineral sunscreen. I love the tint; I love the fact that it gave my face nice touch of color.

I tried this sunscreen in the bronze color, and I love that it's super hydrating and makes my skin look natural with a nice bronze color - perfect in time for this summer! A little goes a long way, and I like that the texture is lightweight but still gives a good amount of color while being super blendable and easy to apply. Also I am very particular with ingredients and I like that it has clean ingredients, protects my skin, and includes skincare so I feel good applying this product on a daily basis.

Absolutely obsessed with this SPF serum! The texture is incredibly lightweight and melts right into my skin. It feels more like skincare than sunscreen. It gives the most beautiful dewy glow without looking greasy, and my skin feels hydrated and smooth all day. I love that it's a mineral SPF 50 with skincare ingredients like niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, so it protects while also making my skin look healthier and more radiant. The subtle tint helps even out my complexion and works perfectly under makeup or on no-makeup days. If you love glowy, hydrated skin with strong sun protection, this one is definitely worth it.

I absolutely love Bloomeffect's Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze Sunscreen! It blends effortlessly into my skin and gives the most beautiful, natural bronzed glow without looking greasy or heavy. The serum texture feels lightweight and hydrating, making it perfect for everyday wear—even under makeup. What really stands out is how dewy and healthy my skin looks after applying it. It evens out my complexion while still feeling breathable, and I appreciate that it provides sun protection without the typical sunscreen smell or white cast. The bronze tint adds just the right amount of warmth, making my skin look radiant and fresh. This has quickly become a staple in my routine for sunny days. If you're looking for a sunscreen that protects, hydrates, and enhances your glow all in one step, this is definitely worth trying!

I liked the color of the tint that I received. It match my skin tone and it was not heavy on my skin. The only thing I didn't like was the dispenser tip. I lightly squeezed the bottle and too much sunscreen came out. I had to use it so it didn't go to waste.

avis.titre: Lightweight Glow and Protection in One!
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Bloom Effects Tulip Screen Dew Serum in 50 Bronze! It gives my skin such a beautiful, natural-looking glow while also providing sun protection. The formula feels lightweight and smooth, and it blends effortlessly into the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. The bronze tint adds the perfect touch of warmth and radiance, making my complexion look healthy and luminous. It works great on its own for a fresh, dewy look or under makeup as a glowing base. I also appreciate that it feels hydrating and comfortable throughout the day. Overall, this is a fantastic product that combines skincare, glow, and SPF in one step. Highly recommend if you want radiant, protected skin!

avis.titre: Great product, needs a better selection of colors
avis.texte: It feels good on the skin Blends in well But the color is too dark and I don't mix it into anything so I can get the correct feedback Needs more colors

I tried this product on the back of my hand when I got it and I thought it was a bit dark but it blended out well and left a nice glow. When I tried it on my face, it was way too dark and and it didn't blend well at all. I had to wash it all off. It doesn't leave a white cast because it just makes you orange. Maybe if you worked in small sections it would blend out better.

I have been enjoying using this dew serum bronze, it gave my skin a beautiful subtle glow. I also loved that it doubles as a sun screen. I will continue to use this product and would recommend it to others.
I love love love it. It makes your skin look flawless and clear., This is must have for us ladies that can appreciate the cover up. It's one of the to go make up products that belong in our purses.
So far, so good. Only used for 1 week but I love the consistency and dewy finish it gives.

avis.titre: A Little Bit Goes A Long Way
avis.texte: I recently had the opportunity to try the Bloomeffects Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronzer, and I was really impressed with the overall formula and performance. The consistency is one of my favorite things about this product. It's not too thick and not too runny either—it has a smooth, serum-like texture that blends easily into the skin. Compared to other bronzing products I've tried, this one feels much lighter and more natural on the skin. Many bronzers can feel heavy or look patchy, but this one applies evenly and gives a subtle, dewy glow. A little goes a long way—I only needed a small amount to cover my entire face, which makes it feel very efficient and easy to work with. It's darker than my skin tone but it blend well. Another thing I noticed is the scent. It's very light and pleasant. It has a slightly warm, almost cinnamon-like scent mixed with a makeup fragrance, but it's not overpowering at all. One of the benefits of owning this product is how versatile and natural it looks. It gives a healthy glow without looking overly made up, which makes it perfect for everyday wear. I especially like that it can be used for a quick, effortless look. It does in the beginning when apply have an oily look, but once it sets for the 15 minutes advised before going in the out. It doesn't have minimal shine, and it does have slight transfer after it sets. I would definitely consider purchasing this product. I think I would also love to try it in a slightly lighter shade for "no-makeup" da

The product itself is not bad, I like the sunscreen component. The color may have been the wrong tint for me, as it was a little dark and made me look "dirty" instead of bronzed. I'd be willing to try another shade.

I recently tried the Bloomeffects Tulipscreen Dew Serum SPF 50 in the Bronze shade (30 ml) and I'm honestly impressed. The formula feels more like a lightweight skincare serum than a traditional sunscreen. It applies smoothly, blends easily into the skin, and leaves a beautiful dewy glow without feeling heavy or greasy. What I really like is that it gives SPF 50 broad-spectrum protection while also delivering skincare benefits. The mineral formula uses zinc oxide for sun protection and includes nourishing ingredients like niacinamide, vitamin C–rich botanicals, and sodium hyaluronate, which help hydrate and brighten the skin. The Bronze tint adds a subtle warmth to the skin that evens out my complexion just enough for those "no-makeup" days. It's perfect if you want a natural glow while still protecting your skin. The finish is definitely radiant and hydrating, so it's great for normal to dry skin types. Overall, this sunscreen feels like skincare + sun protection in one step, and it's become a really nice addition to my daytime routine

At first I thought it was going to be way too dark for my skin, as it is really tinted, but it was easy to blend and only slightly darker than I wanted. It will be perfect in the summer with a tan. I have dry skin and it did not cling to any dry spots. It helped even out my skin tone too, and I didn't have to wear any foundation with it. I also really liked how lightweight this product. I can't wait to use this more on the daily.

avis.titre: Excellent for everyday use in a sunny days
avis.texte: This is a great product so far. I started taking care of my skin including applying sunscreen everyday. When I got this product, I was excited. The packaging has very nice design. The bottle inside the box has great look. I would say the product looks expensive. When I applied for the first time, I like the texture and the sense of glow it leaves. It moisturised my skin and left it looking greasy and healthy.
I like that it is and feels lightweight. The bronze tint seemed really tinted so maybe I should have gotten the lighter shade -I'm Fitzpatrick 3. Will be better when I am tanner during the summer

The product is easy to apply and blends easily. We haven't had much sun lately, but I've used it a few times since receiving it. It also has a nice pleasant scent to it. I will definitely use it daily when we have brighter spring and summer days. I didn't have any problems with the product at all.

I applied the dew serum about 20 minutes before going outside. It has a SPF of 50 so I didn't get sunburned at all. The product is light, easy to use and a little goes a long way. The bronze color of it is perfect for my skin tone , not to light or too dark

avis.titre: A Glowy, Lightweight SPF That Makes My Skin Look So Healthy
avis.texte: I've really been enjoying the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze under the Florida sun. The texture is super lightweight and silky, and it feels more like a hydrating serum than a typical sunscreen. It blends easily and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or heavy. The Bronze tint gives my skin a subtle glow and helps even out my complexion just enough that I can skip makeup on casual days. I also love how hydrating it feels and how healthy and dewy my skin looks after applying it. It layers well with other products too. Note: I received this product as part of a BzzAgent campaign in exchange for my honest review, and I'm really happy I got the chance to try it!

I love how easily it blends in with my skin, the tone match was on point! Love that it has SPF built into as I am easily sunburned. I just used this product and some blush and my makeup was done with a chefs kiss! Im a girly in my 30s and our skins are naturally demanding less makeup now and this was the PERFECT fit into my skin and makeup routine.

Upon first swatch, I was a bit skeptic. I truly didn't think the bronze serum would blend well into my brown skin but boy was I wrong. The serum blended smoothly and evenly across my skin and left it with a nice bronzed glow. As of now, it has not caused any reaction with my acne-prone skin, so fingers crossed that it will continue to work well for me.

First, I think the scent is great! Not scented at all. It feels great on my skin and not heavy or too thick. The amount of dewy shimmer is absolutely beautiful! I used it both with and without makeup. The cons are that the color is too dark for me. If there was a lighter shade, it would be perfect! The bottle is also very difficult to squeeze. I usually have to shake it to get some out. Hopefully that will be addressed in the future!

Am so much loving the TulipScreen Dew Serum. It is very suitable for outdoor activities. The tinted formula, serum bronze provides a subtle mineral tint that help even out my skin tone while protecting my skin from sun damage, giving that natural radiant look.It has a lightweight, hydrating texture that blends well into the skin, offering a fresh, luminous finish rather than a heavy or cakey feel. Perfect for daily use under makeup or on bare skin for a natural glow.

I followed the instructions and shook it really well and applied it to my face and immediately you can see the bronzer but it doesn't go on smoothly so you get these splotchy dark spots of bronzer that kind of looks like dirt. Once it touches your skin it doesn't spread so it just leaves a dark spot and if you go over it it gets darker. It had a very orange tint to it like self tanner almost.

avis.titre: Healthy, sun-kissed glow without looking greasy
avis.texte: Lightweight and dewy with a subtle bronze tint that gives skin a healthy, sun-kissed glow without looking greasy. Layers well under makeup and feels comfortable throughout the day. The packaging is sleek making application easy and mess-free.

avis.titre: Really nice product, not suitable for my skin
avis.texte: At first when I saw the color, I was worried it would be too dark. But it blends in very well and gave a nice glow underneath my makeup and blended well with makeup. I'm sensitive to oil and when I read the ingredient list I knew it might cause problems and I did have a slight breakout but once I changed it to my primer first and then the spf I didn't have as many issues.

I love this tinted vitamin and mineral sunscreen! It really adds a nice bronze hue to your skin, perfect for a no-makeup day at the beach. I used it as a face sunscreen but you could use it anywhere. It comes in a really cute package and the size is travel friendly! I would definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Great base to start your look!
avis.texte: I received Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze Sunscreen for free in exchange for my honest review—and it quickly earned a permanent spot in my daily routine. From the first use, it was an instant yes. The formula feels incredibly lightweight on the skin while creating the perfect base for everything from a quick everyday look to full glam. What really sets it apart is the bronze tint—it's actually noticeable (in the best way) and gives your skin a beautiful, healthy glow without looking heavy or overdone. I also love that it combines multiple steps in my routine—skincare, sunscreen, and a glow booster—so I can get ready faster with fewer products. Effortless glow and sun protection? Absolutely a win in my book.

When I first opened it I thought it would be way too dark but it blends down super seamlessly. It was surprisingly lightweight to make your skin glow while protecting. It did take quite a bit of product to cover my face though. It is perfect if you want a little coverage while having SPF for the day

Cute packaging. I like that the product comes out one drop at a time as a little goes a long way. To cover my face, I only needed 2 drops. The bronze color is quite intimidating as it is very dark, but it went on very sheer. It's probably better for me in the summer when I'm not as pale. Perfect for the long days in the garden. I would be interested to see what the original tint looks like on my winter skin.

avis.titre: Goes on smoothly! Would buy again.
avis.texte: I accidentally ordered a shade slightly darker than my skin tone, but it ended up working perfectly! It gave me a beautiful, naturally sun-kissed glow, so I'll definitely be buying it again. My only critique is the dispenser: the tip is quite sharp/stiff, which makes it hard to control. I often ended up squeezing out too much product, whereas a softer tip would make it easier to dispense just the right amount.

I received a free bottle of the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze in exchange for my honest review. I have tried mineral sunscreen in the past and it always left a white cast on my skin. The Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze leaves a nice glow and no white cast. Some benefits of owning this product is that I can use it when going out in the day time and I'll still have a nice glowy look even though I'm wearing sunscreen. I would buy this product if there was a bigger size at a better value. The 30ml is quite small and it won't last me long with daily use. I would probably recommend this to some of my friends and family.

avis.titre: Nice formula, but Bronze was too warm for me
avis.texte: I received the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze SPF through BzzAgent to try. The formula itself is really nice — it feels more like a lightweight hydrating serum than a traditional sunscreen. It spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and leaves a dewy, healthy-looking finish without feeling heavy or greasy. I tried it both on its own and under light makeup and it layered well without pilling. The only issue for me was the shade. The Bronze tint was a bit too warm and deeper than my natural skin tone, so when I applied enough for proper SPF coverage it made my face look more bronzed than I prefer. I think the Glow version would probably be a better match for my skin tone. Interestingly, my husband has a deeper complexion and he actually really likes using it. On his skin the tint blends in much more naturally and gives a nice subtle glow while still providing sun protection. Overall, the formula is beautiful - lightweight, hydrating, and glowy, but I'd recommend choosing the shade carefully depending on your skin tone.
I can't live without this light sunscreen serum. It's easy to reapply and gives me a beautiful glow! I love it!

avis.titre: Great for those no makeup days!
avis.texte: I'm an L&D nurse and don't always want to do a full face of makeup for work. But SPF is a must every day and this product not only provides SPF 50, but also adds a beautiful tint that evens out my complexion. I was blown away the first time I wore it because it looked like I had makeup on it, but it was just my normal skincare and this SPF. It has become a staple in my daily routine and I will definitely be repurchasing when I run out. I have tinted moisturizers but they don't provide SPF or they barely provide SPF15. The fact that this is SPF50 means I can wear it daily AND for days at the beach!

I used this product while in Mexico. I received so many compliments on the glow of my skin. I am so happy to find a product that provides spf and leaves the skin looking flawless, even and glowing. I will continue to purchase. I received this product free to review and absolutely love it.

I've been using the Bloomeffects Tulipscreen Dew Serum SPF 50 in Bronze and really like how lightweight it feels on my skin. The tint gives a soft bronzed glow that looks natural and healthy without feeling heavy. It's a great option for days when I want a little coverage while still protecting my skin with SPF.
I love this serum! It is very lightweight and blends in flawlessly. It is so lightweight you wear your makeup over it or by itself since it is tinted.

I've been using the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze Sunscreen 30ml, and I think it's great for spring and summer. The formula feels super lightweight and hydrating, almost like a serum, so it melts right into my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. I really love the bronze tint. It gives my skin a beautiful sun-kissed glow that instantly makes my complexion look healthier and more radiant. It's perfect for those days when I want a natural no-makeup look but still want my skin to look even and luminous. My complexion is pretty pale in the winter so I think it's more suitable for spring and summer because it make my skins tone much more warmer than my body.

avis.titre: Safe sun kissed look with protection!
avis.texte: As an age, I am reluctant to tan, even though I want to be brown as can be so this was a great product to try. Usually when I've used a product like this, it did not have SPF so I was extra extra pleased. I'm also thankful it is fragrance free because I will use it for layering! I love that it feels light moisturizing without feeling greasy or heavy! I liked using a fin out approach for overall coverage or double applying in certain areas for contouring I wore a light layer of bb cream on top and did not have any caking! I think this is great enough to use daily as part of my regular routine

I really appreciate that this SPF is tinted so you don't get the leftover white cast and it can provide minor skin tone evening. I am Mexican and my skin tone is on the lighter side of Olive--i usually buy Honey Beige or Light Beige makeup. I got the Bronze color of this SPF but I'd say it's a better match with my tanned/summer skin tone. I would go one shade lighter for spring/winter use. This is very lightweight and more on the watery side, but does feel tacky at first. After 5 minutes it was slightly tacky still. By 10 minutes it felt totally smoothe and I didn't notice it on my skin. (I may be a bit on the sensitive side though as I normally wear very lightweight or simple makeup). This also had a very very subtle cinnamon smell that I noticed for the first couple minutes but it disappeared quickly as it dried. If you are sensitive to any fragrance at all, this may not be for you. I do have a pretty good sense of smell but I had to either apply this right around my nose or put the swatch right up to my nose to be able to smell it--even then it was fairly faint. So i would say it's sti acceptable for those who prefer low to unscented products. I generally don't have sensitive skin though, so I can't say much on that front. Personally, I didn't have any reactions or breakouts with this when sticking to 1 to 2 applications per day.

avis.titre: Like the glow this serum gives!
avis.texte: I liked this SPF serum for the thin texture that was easy to apply and it gave a nice healthy glow. The shade that I tried was a little dark for my skin tone, but I will definitely try a lighter shade in the future. I really like the idea of a ski tint with SPF already included. One less step to worry about!

I was gifted the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze Sunscreen in exchange for my honest review. I am new to using tinted sunscreen, but this is nice. The color matches my skin perfectly. I originally thought it was too dark and thought it would have a bronzer-like/glowing effect. It doesn't, so I will wear bronzer on top. It feels light on the skin and covers minor imperfections. This is a perfect go to for me since I stopped using foundation. It covers what I need it to cover, is lightweight, applies easily, protects from sun damage, and rinses off well. Definitely recommend.

Loved how pigmented and blendable this mineral tinted sunscreen was on my tan skin. All other mineral sunscreens have left a white tint on my skin but this did not! It also layered nicely in areas where I had breakouts and I needed extra coverage. I was able to apply my regular make-up over it for virtual meetings. I even got a compliments on how my skin looked at the store. The only downside is gets on the inside of the cap but that's like any other sunscreen, make up or bronze serums. Definitely recommend this for anyone looking for a lightweight tinted sunscreen.

(*I received this product free for an honest review) I Absolutely love this tinted sunscreen. It's super light on the skin. I live in the desert so, wearing sunscreen is a must for me. I don't like to wear heavy foundations during the day and have tried other tinted sunscreens but the colors never match my complexion. The bronze blended in perfectly with my skin and left no oily residue as others have.

I love using this product to even my skin and offer a glowing affect. It not only makes my skin flawless, but helps my skin stay protected from the suns harmful rays. My skin is soft and stays that way. This serum gives me a boost of bronze color!

I love this sunscreen because it's skincare with a touch of makeup. I was worried as a person of color sunscreen is hard for me because I tend to get casting.Bloomeffects made this sunscreen not only waterproof, but added some bronze color that prevents the white casting .I have combination skin and this did not make my skin greasy nor break me out.
I loveeeee this product so much i wish it came in a bigger ounce. I've tried a lot of tinted mineral sunscreens and none of them were ever dark enough to blend seamlessly.

avis.titre: The perfect sunscreen with a glowy finish!
avis.texte: I received this product for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze sunscreen for a week and have been loving it! The sunscreen has a light, pleasant scent, doesn't leave a white cast and provides great coverage! I have caramel skin and the bronze shade was perfect for me!

avis.titre: Great Texture, But Needs Better Shades
avis.texte: I've been enjoying the Tulipscreen Dew Serum SPF 50 so far. The texture is really nice - it's fragrance‑free, spreads easily which is great as a serum, and feels comfortable on the skin without that heavy sunscreen feel. It gives a very nice subtle glow to the skin and the tint is perfect for people who the tint shade works well for. I also appreciate that it's made with upcycled tulips; I'm not totally sure what that means in practice, but I like that the brand is trying to use more natural, sustainable ingredients. The only thing that doesn't quite work for me is the shade range. The current options lean very light or very dark, and neither sits well on a medium skin tone. If they added a true medium shade, this would be a product I'd reach for all the time.
This is my first time using this type of sunscreen and I'm really impressed. It not like other sunscreen that feels heavy, oily or leave white caste. It absorbs quickly leaving skin glowy dewy.

This product gave me a perfect glow- slightly dewy and hydrating. I love the bronze effect. I have medium- tan skin and the color blended perfectly and gave me a nice color. I love that it also has spf to protect my skin in the summer

This is such a great product. It's super lightweight but it gives your skin the perfect glow especially in these dull winter months. I love the ingredients and the size is great for the price. A little goes a long way and I love that you can layer this with a tinted moisturizer for a natural look that still keeps your skin protected.

avis.titre: A smooth and well blended sunscreen!
avis.texte: This is such a great formulation! I mean the skin match is impressive. I have to say thanks to Bloom Effects for the free Tulipscreen! I typically have an issue finding tinted mineral sunscreens that matches my skin with no cast - this does it. I like that it doesn't feel greasy after applying and it does work well under my make-up as well. The tint is just right for everyday coverage. I really enjoy this and will keep in my rotation!

avis.titre: I wouldn't buy this again based on I found it hard to apply
avis.texte: *I received this product for free in exchange for writing this review* I have tried a few products from Bloomeffects before and loved them all. The first time I tried this I put too much on and it did not blend well. The key is to be really heavily moisturized. I do have dry skin and I do live in the desert for reference. This product being a bronzer plus containing SPF 50 appealed to me. It takes a bit of getting used to and I found for me at least, it's best to add a little bit of bronzer to a moisturizer as well as already having a base with some slip. If you have oily skin and live in a humid state it may be easier to apply. You do not need much. This bottle will last a long time. The color was good and very natural but just not for me.
I really like this product, it's leave my skin feeling light and natural

avis.titre: Loved the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze Sunscreen
avis.texte: I received the Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze Sunscreen for free in exchange for my honest review. I loved it! The first thing I noticed was the tint. Though it looked drak it went on with a sheer coverage that looked great on my skin. I was most amazed and happy that it did not feel oily and heavy like most face sunscreens. It was easy to apply and build the color as desired. I recommend it for a great sunscreen with natural looking color and coverage.

avis.titre: Bronzed, Glowing, and Sun-Protected All Day!
avis.texte: The Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze is my go-to when I want sun protection and a glow-up at the same time! I use it as the last step in my morning skincare routine. After cleansing and moisturizing, I apply a few drops to my face and blend it in like a serum. It feels lightweight and smooth, not heavy or greasy, which I love. As soon as I rub it in, my skin gets this warm, bronzy glow that makes me look like I just got back from vacation. I sometimes wear it alone on no-makeup days for that natural sun-kissed look, or I use it under foundation when I want extra radiance. It gives me that dewy, healthy shine while protecting my skin from the sun, so I feel confident and protected all day long. It is such a fun way to stay glowing and safe at the same time!

I don't know if there were multiple shades but the one i was given was too dark. It almost was like putting on bronzer all over your face, I was thinking it was a tinted sunscreen. So I tried it again but diluted it with moisturizer and followed up with my regular sunscreen. This was too much work to make the shade work for me. The packaging is the cutest and I loved the story that came on the box about tulips and their regenerative capabilities.
This product seems like it would be very good and I wanted to like it but it was the wrong shade for me. I feel it would be hard to find the right one.

avis.titre: Makes my face look bronzed and beautiful
avis.texte: I put this serum on before I went to the pool and I loved that it instantly gave my face and skin a bronzed glowy look. It didn't make my face look shiny or overly dark but just a perfect look without having to add makeup. I did add a little blush to my cheeks for contrast but overall this is a new staple in my summer bag. I did mark one star off because I'm not super fond of the smell. It blended well but the smell of the product was just ok. I was expecting like a summer or coconut hint but it just didn't smell the way I had anticipated. Overall great product under makeup or on no makeup days where you just need a little glow
I was a little disappointed after all the hype. It made my skin look a little pale and muddy. I added more moisturizer and it's ok. I can't speak for the sun protection, but hoping for the best.

avis.titre: Great for daily use - smooth and it doesn't feel heavy.
avis.texte: I received a free full-size sample (30ml) of Tulipscreen Dew Serum Bronze Sunscreen as part of the BzzAgent program in exchange for my honest review. I really like the texture — it feels very light on the skin and glides on smoothly, absorbing quickly without feeling heavy like some other products that contain sunscreen. It gives a soft tint that makes my skin look slightly darker, almost like a subtle, natural tan. It doesn't have shimmer or glow, and it doesn't provide heavy coverage for blemishes or imperfections — but that's not what it's meant for. It fits beautifully into a simple daily routine. If you're looking for a lightweight sunscreen with a hint of tint for everyday wear, this is a great option. I would definitely buy it and recommend it to my friends and family.
